title: Among schools with a total SAT score (sum of Math, Reading, and Writing ave
question: Among schools with a total SAT score (sum of Math, Reading, and Writing averages) above 1500, find the two most common administrator first names. For each of these names, list all associated schools that are magnet programs (Magnet = 1).

prediction.sql:
WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s."XCL_041" AS cds_code
    FROM schools AS s
    INNER JOIN satscores AS sat ON s."XCL_041" = sat."XCL_030"
    WHERE (sat."XCL_037" + sat."XCL_038" + sat."XCL_039") > 1500
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT s."XCL_080" AS admin_first_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM schools AS s
    INNER JOIN eligible_schools AS es ON s."XCL_041" = es.cds_code
    WHERE s."XCL_080" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s."XCL_080"
    ORDER BY cnt DESC, s."XCL_080" ASC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT s."XCL_080" AS admin_first_name, s."XCL_047" AS school_name
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN name_counts AS nc ON s."XCL_080" = nc.admin_first_name
WHERE s."XCL_077" = 1
ORDER BY s."XCL_080", s."XCL_047"

WITH eligible_schools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s."XCL_041" AS cds_code
    FROM schools AS s
    INNER JOIN satscores AS sat ON s."XCL_041" = sat."XCL_030"
    WHERE (sat."XCL_037" + sat."XCL_038" + sat."XCL_039") > 1500
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT s."XCL_080" AS admin_first_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM schools AS s
    INNER JOIN eligible_schools AS es ON s."XCL_041" = es.cds_code
    WHERE s."XCL_080" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY s."XCL_080"
    ORDER BY cnt DESC, s."XCL_080" ASC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT s."XCL_080" AS admin_first_name, s."XCL_047" AS school_name
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN name_counts AS nc ON s."XCL_080" = nc.admin_first_name
WHERE s."XCL_077" = 1
ORDER BY s."XCL_080", s."XCL_047"

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T2."XCL_012", T1."XCL_041"
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1."XCL_041" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN satscores AS T3 ON T1."XCL_041" = T3."XCL_030"
WHERE (T3."XCL_037" + T3."XCL_038" + T3."XCL_039") > 1500
  AND T2."XCL_013" = 1
  AND T2."XCL_012" IN (
    SELECT F."XCL_012"
    FROM frpm AS F
    INNER JOIN satscores AS SS ON F."XCL_001" = SS."XCL_030"
    WHERE (SS."XCL_037" + SS."XCL_038" + SS."XCL_039") > 1500
    GROUP BY F."XCL_012"
    ORDER BY COUNT(F."XCL_012") DESC
    LIMIT 2
  )

    WHERE (sat.XCL_035 + sat.XCL_036 + sat.XCL_037) > 1500
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT

FROM filtered_schools fs

WHERE fs.magnet = 1
ORDER BY fs.administrator_first_name, fs.school_name
